digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and container scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` must be neutral in scope inheritance: it contributes no paths and does not poison sibling path declarations.
Any live `undeclared` child poisons child inheritance and forces the container to remain unscoped unless the parent has explicit paths or citations.
All-none scope is true only when at least one live child exists and every live child is authenticated `none`; no live children must not synthesize `none`.

Scope precedence is exact: own or inherited dependency paths yield `paths`; explicit parent `none` yields `none`; all-live-children-none promotes only an undeclared parent to `none`; otherwise the result is unscoped.
Mixed live `paths` and `none` children must sign only the path child dependencies and survive unrelated file drift.
P9 must pass leaves and containers whose live children are all declared, and advise only live undeclared children naming both path declaration and `--none` as truthful remedies.
